title: Grocery Restock Prediction
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=supply:level category=groceries
| stats latest(level_pct) as level, avg(daily_use_pct) as usage by item
| eval days_left=round(level/usage,1), add_to_list=if(days_left<4,1,0)
| where add_to_list=1
| sort days_left
description: Predicts which fridge and pantry staples will run out within days and builds your next shopping list automatically.
value: An auto-built restock list means fewer forgotten items and fewer midweek shop dashes.
implementation: Ingest grocery levels into `index=personal`; surface items to add to the shopping list.
visualization: Table of groceries to restock by days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts which food staples are about to run out and adds them to your shopping list for you.
